calculation_handling.description: The minimum required lot frontage is the lot frontage that existed on the date of enactment of By-law 569-2013; this needs the as-built history of the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: Existing lot frontage on the enactment date is not held.

units.disclosure: If the lot frontage existed on the date of the enactment of By-law 569-2013 (May 9, 2013), you may use that existing frontage as the minimum required lot frontage, provided the lot is within Exception RT 324. A new build is answered as if this does not apply.

calculation_handling.description: The minimum required lot area is the lot area that existed on the date of enactment of By-law 569-2013; this needs the as-built history of the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: Existing lot area on the enactment date is not held.

units.disclosure: If the lot area existed on the date of the enactment of By-law 569-2013 (May 9, 2013), you may use that existing area as the minimum required lot area, provided the lot is within Exception RT 324. A new build is answered as if this does not apply.

calculation_handling.description: A maximum of one dwelling unit on each lot; no vocabulary target is licensed by the clause wording.
calculation_handling.gaps: Dwelling-unit count limit has no licensed target pattern in this wording.

units.disclosure: Exception RT 324 allows a maximum of one dwelling unit on each lot; this limit is not evaluated by the tool.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum building setback of 7.5 metres from a lot line that abuts Kennedy Rd.; a setback from a lot line abutting a named road has no target.
calculation_handling.gaps: Setback from the lot line abutting a named road (Kennedy Rd.) has no target.

units.disclosure: Where a lot line abuts Kennedy Rd., the minimum building setback from that lot line is 7.5 metres; this is not evaluated by the tool.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum building setback of 6.0 metres from any other front lot line that abuts a street (other than the Kennedy Rd. lot line); no front-setback pattern is licensed by this wording.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 'any other front lot line that abuts a street' wording matches no licensed front or street setback pattern and depends on the Kennedy Rd. arm.

units.disclosure: The minimum building setback is 6.0 metres from any other front lot line that abuts a street; this is not evaluated by the tool.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum building setback of 4.5 metres from a side lot line that abuts a street.
Minimum building setback of 1.2 metres from a side lot line.
The portion of a building with a parking space is set back at least 0.3 metres from a side lot line.
A required parking space must be located in the residential building.
A residential building may not exceed 2 storeys.
Minimum building setback from a lot line for a below grade parking structure is the greater of 3.0 metres and the depth-equivalent distance in (J)(ii); only the 3.0 metre arm is modelled.
calculation_handling.gaps: The (J)(ii) depth-equivalent arm and the below grade parking structure scope are not modelled.

calculation_handling.description: The setback arm equal to the vertical distance from the lowest floor of a below grade parking structure to the average elevation of grade at the front lot line; no such measurement is held.
calculation_handling.gaps: Structure floor depth and average grade at the front lot line are not held.

units.disclosure: For a below grade parking structure, the minimum setback is the greater of 3.0 metres and a distance equal to the vertical distance from the lowest floor surface to the average grade at the front lot line; the second distance is not evaluated by the tool.

calculation_handling.description: No prevailing by-laws or sections apply.
Former City of Etobicoke by-law 1978-154 prevails as an alternate compliance path; it is not evaluated.

units.disclosure: Former City of Etobicoke by-law 1978-154 is a prevailing by-law for these lands; it is not evaluated by the tool.

calculation_handling.description: Former City of Etobicoke by-law 1995-43 prevails as an alternate compliance path; it is not evaluated.

units.disclosure: Former City of Etobicoke by-law 1995-43 is a prevailing by-law for these lands; it is not evaluated by the tool.

900.5.10(324).explanation: Exception RT 324 sets site specific rules for these lands: lot frontage and area as they existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, one dwelling unit per lot, set backs of 7.5 m (Kennedy Rd.), 6.0 m (other front lot lines on a street), 4.5 m (side lot lines on a street) and 1.2 m (side lot lines, 0.3 m for the portion with a parking space), required parking inside the residential building, 50% lot coverage, a 2 storey limit and below grade parking structure setbacks. No prevailing by-laws apply.

900.5.10(4).explanation: Exception RT 4 has no site specific provisions; former City of Etobicoke by-law 1978-154 prevails and is not evaluated by the tool.

900.5.10(7).explanation: Exception RT 7 has no site specific provisions; former City of Etobicoke by-law 1995-43 prevails and is not evaluated by the tool.
